method: Each presentation was read by eye from contact sheets of every sampled frame, and each drawn shape compared against the reference diagram of the name. Every complete sequence was then found as a row of glyph.csv. Nothing here was generated by the recognizer, the tracker, or the predictor. Times are seconds on the extracted frame timeline. A null slot was not visible in the capture: the frames were lost to a capture gap or show only part of the shape.
